CFML Language Reference: Tags

CFCONTENT

CFCONTENT tells the browser what kind of document it is getting. Use TYPE to send plain text, comma-separated data for a spreadsheet, or anything else your page generates; use FILE to send an existing file (a PDF, an image, a download) straight from disk.

Category

Output and page processing

Syntax

<CFCONTENT TYPE="file_type"
    FILE="filename"
    DELETEFILE="Yes/No"
    RESET="Yes/No">

Attributes

TYPE
Optional. MIME type of the response, for example "text/plain", "application/vnd.ms-excel" or "image/gif". If you send a FILE without a TYPE, KoldFusion guesses the type from the file extension.
FILE
Optional. Full path of a file to send as the response body. Processing of the page stops at the tag.
DELETEFILE
Optional, default "No". "Yes" deletes FILE after it has been sent. Handy for temporary reports.
RESET
Optional, default "Yes". "Yes" discards any output the page generated before the tag, so the response contains only what comes after it (or the FILE). "No" keeps it.

Usage

CFCONTENT can be restricted in the Administrator (Basic Security, Tag Restrictions), because FILE can read any file the server can. Restricted tags only work in templates under the unsecured tags directory.

Use CFHEADER to add a header such as Content-Disposition when you want the browser to offer a "Save As" dialog. If you send plain text, remember that the browser shows it verbatim: HTML tags will appear as text.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<!--- Everything before CFCONTENT is thrown away by RESET="Yes" --->
<H1>You will not see this heading</H1>
<CFQUERY NAME="Depts" DATASOURCE="cfsnippets">
SELECT Dept_Name, Location FROM Departments ORDER BY Dept_Name
</CFQUERY>
<CFCONTENT TYPE="text/plain" RESET="Yes"><CFOUTPUT>KoldFusion department report (text/plain)
Generated #DateFormat(Now(), "mm/dd/yyyy")# #TimeFormat(Now(), "HH:mm")#

<CFLOOP QUERY="Depts">#LJustify(Dept_Name, 16)##Location#
</CFLOOP>
#Depts.RecordCount# departments. <B>Tags</B> are shown as text in a text/plain page.
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

CFHEADER, CFFILE, CFLOCATION, GetTempFile
